integrity: Exact probabilities are derived by semisimple reduction, bimodule gauge splitting and full-rank matrices; independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Split basic finite-dimensional unital associative algebras only; prime-power fields are permitted. Sparse asymptotic additionally requires bounded arrow multiplicity and linear total arrow count. Small exhaustive finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem. Publication-priority uncertainty about other formulations remains.
title: Gabriel-quiver universality and a birthday threshold for random generators of finite split basic algebras
